title: Longitudinal single-cell transcriptomics analysis of mouse lung upon bleomycin-induced injury
summary: Two single-cell RNA sequencing data sets were generated called "Whole lung" and "High Resolution". The "Whole lung" single-cell mRNAseq libraries were generated with Drop-Seq from whole mouse lungs upon bleomycin-induced injury and followed over time. Samples were taken at days 3 (n = 3), 7 (n = 5), 10 (n = 3), 14 (n = 4), 21 (n = 4) and 28 (n = 2). Control samples (n = 7) were administered saline only, also indicated with PBS or day0. The "High resolution" single-cell mRNAseq libraries were generated with Drop-Seq from the epithelial compartment of mouse lungs upon bleomycin-induced injury and followed over time. Samples were taken daily for two weeks and at days 21, 28, 36, 54 after injury. Control samples (n = 2) were administered saline only, also indicated with PBS or day0.

title: hires_d36_1 [muc9265]
data_processing:
For the single-cell RNA-seq data the Drop-Seq core computational pipeline was used for processing next generation sequencing reads of the scRNA-seq data, as previously described (Pubmed ID: 26000488). For the whole lung tissue and flow-sorted bulk RNA-seq data, STAR (Pubmed ID:  23104886) was used to align the reads to reference genome mm10 followed by featureCounts (Pubmed ID: 24227677) for gene summarization.
Genome_build: mm10
Supplementary_files_format_and_content: For the "High resolution" experiment: Raw count matrix (HighResolution_rawcounts.mtx) from Drop-seq experiments with 24051 genes and 34068 cells in market matrix format and corresponding column (HighResolution_barcodes.txt) and row (HighResolution_genes.txt) labels and cell-level metadata (WholeLung_cellinfo.csv). For the "Whole lung" experiment: Raw count matrix (WholeLung_rawcounts.mtx) from Drop-seq experiments with 23400 genes and 29297 cells in market matrix format and corresponding column (WholeLung_barcodes.txt) and row (WholeLung_genes.txt) labels and cell-level metadata (WholeLung_cellinfo.csv).
